# Find row where Programme Code header appears
# Row 3 has 'Programme Code' in col0
# Row 4 has 'Apr 2025' in col4 etc
# Data starts at row 5 (index 5)
start_row = 5
# Determine columns
# Let's read from start_row with header from row 4?
# Simpler: read rows 4 onwards, set columns from row 4 and 3
# Actually header is two rows: row3 has main headers, row4 has month names
# Let's construct manually

# Get rows
data_rows = df_raw.iloc[start_row:].reset_index(drop=True)
print("Total rows from start:", len(data_rows))
print(data_rows.head(20).to_string())
# Show tail
print(data_rows.tail(10).to_string())
